sentences.en: You should see this film if you get the opportunity.
sentences.zh: 如果你有机会的话，你应该去看这部电影。

sentences.en: This is a great opportunity to increase our market share.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的机会，可以扩大我们的市场份额。

sentences.en: Every opportunity is used, and you should do English practice.
sentences.zh: 每次有空都要利用机会练习英语。

senses.zh: 机会,适当的时机良机,有利的环境，条件

mnemonic: 词根记忆：op（加强）+port（运）+uni+ ty（表状态）→是搬运某物的时候→机会

collocations.en: take the opportunity to do sth./of doing sth
collocations.zh: 趁机做某事，借机做某事
